items.title: zworld_actor_adequacy_locus H-F: OVER-CAPACITY DECODER SWEEP on the banked V3-EXQ-1002/1008 dataset -- is the oracle's decision-relevant content recoverable from the frozen 978-OFF z_world at ANY decoder capacity? Representation held fixed, decoder capacity swept over 5 rungs (fitted-linear -> the consumer's own 32->128 PPO trunk -> 2048-wide -> a 4-layer 2048 over-parameterised decoder, a ~77,000x parameter range) on three 32-dim tracks: the frozen latent (subject), PCA-32 of the encoder's own input (protocol anchor) and the untrained latent (negative control); 16 arms x 3 seeds
items.note: OVER-CAPACITY DECODER SWEEP adjudicating H-F-content-discarded-at-encode, the single leg left live on frozen-ledger question zworld_actor_adequacy_locus. Routed by the CONFIRMED, user-gated failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1008_2026-09-08 section 8 route 1 (REE_assembly 3f86587d6d; Step 8 gate held 2026-09-08T06:18:57Z, all four recommendations accepted). NEW NUMBER, not a 1008 letter: that autopsy's section 7 REFUSES a lettered 1008b re-running the same design at more power, and this is not that -- 1008 held the READER'S CAPACITY FIXED at the consumer's width and varied the INPUT REPRESENTATION; this holds the REPRESENTATION FIXED and varies the DECODER'S CAPACITY, which no run in the 813->948->978->1002->1008 lineage has done (autopsy section 4c). claim_ids DELIBERATELY EMPTY (INV-088/MECH-457 peripheral per the 978 autopsy; MECH-457's re-derive brake stands at 13, INV-088's at 2 -- re-attaching either would increment a brake counter on a run exercising neither mechanism). EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE diagnostic. | DESIGN: 16 arms x 3 seeds = 1 instrument gate + 3 tracks x 5 capacity rungs. Rungs (action-path params MEASURED by --self-test at in_dim 32): linear 165 -> mlp128 21,381 -> mlp512 282,117 -> mlp2048 4,274,181 -> deep2048x4 12,666,885, a ~77,000x range. mlp128 IS x734.PPOPolicyNet at PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN, i.e. the consumer's own reader (21,381 matches 1008's reported action-path count for every 32-dim arm exactly). Tracks: zworld_off (frozen 978-OFF latent, THE SUBJECT; 1008 at mlp128 = 0.6686 mean, 0/3 clear), ws250_pca (PCA-32 of the encoder's own 250-dim input, THE CALIBRATION ANCHOR certifying the PROTOCOL; 1008 = 0.8684, 3/3 clear), zworld_untrained (warmup skipped, THE NEGATIVE CONTROL attributing an ELIMINATED verdict; 1008 = 0.699/0.681/0.704, ABOVE the trained latent on every seed -- costs no warmup). | VERDICT: per (track,seed) the MAX held-out oracle-action agreement OVER RUNGS (a max, not the top rung: an over-parameterised decoder may overfit and fall). OFF best clears 0.80 bar + 0.20 elevation on >=2/3 seeds -> H-F ELIMINATED, content survives the encode, repair is INTERFACE REFORMATTING (the cheap build); does not clear while both guards hold -> H-F CONFIRMED, content DESTROYED at encode, repair is at the ENCODER'S OBJECTIVE (the expensive build). Those two builds differ by >1 order of magnitude in cost, which is why the autopsy bought one banked-data probe rather than building. | GUARD 1 overcapacity_fit_protocol_sound: anchor(deep2048x4) - anchor(mlp128) >= -0.10, worst seed. NOT best-minus-consumer, which is >=0 by construction and could never fire. | GUARD 2 overcapacity_decoder_can_memorise: OFF TRAIN-split agreement, MAX OVER RUNGS, >= 0.95 worst seed -- a decoder that memorises and still cannot generalise has not failed for want of capacity. Either guard failing, or a red verdict arm, self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue and NEVER a content verdict. | AUTHORING-TIME MEASUREMENT, full dataset scale, seed 42, anchor track (no warmup needed), experiments/_scratch/exq1010_topring_trainability_probe.py: n_train_rows 5038 / n_heldout 2148 (reproduces 1008's 5038/4997/4423). mlp128 final_ce 0.1061 train 0.9653 heldout 0.8836 (1.7s); mlp2048 0.0027 / 1.0000 / 0.8780 (24.7s); deep2048x4 0.0111 / 0.9978 / 0.8641 (66.1s). NONE diverges, the over-capacity rungs DEMONSTRABLY MEMORISE (0.998-1.000 vs the 0.95 floor), Guard 1's delta would be -0.0195 (inside -0.10, and negative -- added capacity mildly overfits, which is what the guard exists to bound), and held-out agreement is FLAT-TO-DECLINING in capacity ON A REPRESENTATION THAT DOES CARRY THE CONTENT (0.8836->0.8780->0.8641), which is why the verdict is an absolute bar plus elevation and never a within-track capacity trend. | GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is held-out oracle_action_agreement as a function of DECODER CAPACITY on a fixed representation. Absent from every manifest in the lineage by construction -- 1002 and 1008 both PINNED capacity at the consumer's width as a deliberate capacity_match requirement, which the 1008 autopsy names as the lineage's observation bottleneck ('no run in the lineage varies the reader's capacity'). Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. | 2.5b brake: no claim tagged; a diagnostic discriminator is explicitly permitted, and the autopsy's own R1-R3 re-run records the counters unchanged with this target claim-free so the counter never reaches it. | 2.5c: SD-018 (degrading; stack.py/zworld_p0.py/agent.py) is exercised by the warmup BY DESIGN -- the latent must be 978's, defects included; open corrupting entries on agent.py/config.py (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082) name mechanisms this DV never reads (supervised decode of a FROZEN latent; action selection is never consulted). Same disposition V3-EXQ-1008 landed under, on a strictly smaller exposure. | DV-SYMMETRY per arm: DV is per-state argmax agreement with the oracle's discrete action; its symmetry group is any logit transform preserving per-state argmax (broadcast additive constant, positive monotone rescaling, permutation of interchangeable units). The manipulation is a change of the decoder's FUNCTION CLASS (parameter count and depth) and is invariant under NONE of them: it is not an offset (a larger function class is not a constant), not a monotone rescaling (the ranking itself is what changes), not a permutation (rungs are ordered by capacity and not exchangeable). It reaches the DV through the fitted decoder's held-out argmax. rawfield_ceiling carries no capacity manipulation at all -- it is the instrument gate and is excluded from every capacity comparison and from the verdict. The reader-free witness has no fitted action head in its path, so the logit-symmetry group does not apply to it. | DV_HEADROOM declared: agreement_elevation (ceiling headroom over the strongest trivial predictor, margin 2.0) and agreement_absolute (rawfield ceiling 0.973-0.985 vs the 0.80 bar), both inherited from 1002/1008 unchanged. | FINGERPRINTS: all 48 cells stamped, include_driver_script_in_hash=False with x1002/x1008/x724/x734/x737/x808 folded via extra_substrate_paths; OFF and untrained cells stamped reuse-INELIGIBLE (the frozen agent is shared across that track's five rungs); decoder init re-seeded from the cell seed before every fit, so paired differentials carry no init-draw component. | SMOKE: --self-test 14 grid rows + whole-cube invariants incl. capacity strictly increasing (exit 0); validate_experiments.py --strict OK with 0 warnings across all 37 checks; --dry-run exit 0, all 16 arms exercised incl. the warmup, the witness at every rung and the saturation refit, 16/16 arm fingerprints, correct dry-scale insufficient_seeds self-route, validate_recording --strict OK, z_goal_stream recorded with no writer defect. | red-team (fable): CONTESTED, no BLOCKING, ONE pass (not re-spawned -- no finding changed the causal chain without also being applied). EIGHT findings, each verified at source; SIX APPLIED, TWO DISCLOSED. F1 APPLIED (HIGH: the frozen-latent reproduction band ROUTED NOWHERE -- gate_green read per_arm_gate.non_degenerate, which is ANY-arm-green by design, so the instrument arm alone satisfied it while the band failed and a content verdict still fired; fixed by an explicit verdict_ready = every VERDICT ARM green BY NAME, checked before both guards, with its own load-bearing criterion and two self-test rows). F1b APPLIED (HIGH, same finding: the draft had silently DROPPED x1002's own preconditions -- zworld_encoder_trained_in_p0, zworld_not_collapsed, oracle_labels_non_degenerate, heldout_split_sufficient, d3_local_view_greedy_clears_floor; now PRECONDITION_SPECS = list(x1002.PRECONDITION_SPECS) + NEW, as 1008 does, with measured computed PER ARM so a track's encoder health is certified by its own cells). F2 APPLIED then SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT (HIGH: fixed Adam lr across 77,000x confounds capacity with trainability, citing the smoke's diverging deep rung; grad-clip at 1.0 added IDENTICALLY at every rung so the manipulation stays capacity alone, plus a per-rung diverged flag and Guard 2 as a max-over-rungs -- then the full-scale probe above showed the divergence was purely a DRY-SCALE artifact and every rung fits. The reviewer's per-rung learning rate was NOT adopted: it would vary two things at once to fix a problem that does not exist at the scale this runs at). F3 APPLIED (CONFIRMED was inseparable from 'map present but under-sampled', and the draft's '~7,900 training rows' was wrong -- corrected to 1008's measured 5038/4997/4423, independently reproduced at 5038, and a sample_saturation_witness added: the OFF mlp512 rung refit on 50% of training rows with the held-out delta recorded. RECORDED not gated -- sample size is a different axis from the one the autopsy's routing named). F4 APPLIED (no untrained track, so ELIMINATED could not be attributed to the ENCODE rather than the 250->32 BOTTLENECK -- and 1008 measured the untrained latent ABOVE the trained one on every seed, so this was live, not theoretical; a full third track added at zero warmup cost, plus off_minus_untrained_best per seed and an explicit line in the ELIMINATED branch). F5 APPLIED (the docstring described Guard 1 in the DEGENERATE best-minus-consumer form the code had already rejected). F6 APPLIED (_worst_cell returns (0.0,None) on empty, which would fail Guard 1 OPEN, and the anchor rows carried no cell_id so the offending seed always reported null; cell_id supplied, and the fail-open path DISCLOSED as unreachable because the instrument gate and verdict_ready both precede Guard 1 and both require the very arms whose absence would empty that list). F7 APPLIED (the reader-free witness had no baseline and no collapse guard -- the smoke showed the DIVERGED rung producing the HIGHEST witness agreement, 0.60, with decision-coordinate r2 of -50.9, a near-constant decode laundering the label marginal; added nonlinear_decode_margin_over_trivial, a nonlinear_decode_collapsed flag on negative decision-coord r2, and a run-level collapsed_witness_rungs set). F8 APPLIED (criteria whose statistic is a max over rungs were owned by the top rung, so a diverged top rung would report non_degenerate:false for a verdict that came cleanly off another rung; now owned by the consumer rung). SEPARATELY, validate_experiments caught a false-cache-HIT the red team did not: GRAD_CLIP_NORM and SATURATION_FRACTION are readout-affecting constants that were absent from the declared config_slice of a cross-driver-reusable fingerprint -- both now declared as dict() keywords, which is the spelling the audit can actually resolve. Findings file: scratchpad redteam_1010.md.

items.title: SD-082 validation, DESIGN CHANGE: raw discrimination index scored TRAINED-MINUS-INIT-HEAD (paired per tick), new seeds, ARM_ON-scoped liveness distance gate, C4 detectability-scoped (5 seeds x 2 arms; supersedes V3-EXQ-822e)
items.note: Design-changed successor to V3-EXQ-822e per the CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822e_2026-09-05 (Fable red-team CONTESTED at Step 7c; Step 8 user gate: "no replay; 822f = init-head control + new seeds; non_contributory both held"). A byte-identical replay is REFUSED (822e was a bit-for-bit replay of 822d's P0-P2). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): the decisive readout -- the raw-stage discrimination index through the INIT head paired per tick with the trained head on the same summaries and the same live rule_state -- is recorded in NO manifest (822e recorded only the trained head's index; its init snapshot is a norm, not a head) -> NOT RECOVERABLE -> run; the OFFLINE RE-SCORE of 822e's rows (abs() on the signed delta: 19/19 readiness, C1/C2 pass) is carried in the manifest as provenance_822e_offline_rescore, explicitly NOT evidence (autopsy (e)). THE FIVE RATIFIED REQUIREMENTS: (a) load-bearing C1' = trained-minus-init discrimination index, ARM_ON, mean over seeds >= max(0.5, 1 sd of D) AND D > 0 on >= 4/5 seeds (paired sign clause); mirrored for weakens; else inconclusive; the in-run init-head median spread is RECORDED as the init-distribution reference, not part of the requirement (red-team F1); 822e's absolute C1 (index >= 1.0, cleared by a random-init head 99% of the time) and C2 (pooled flips) are REPORTED with their init-head counterparts and gate nothing; (b) NEW seeds 611/622/633/644/655; (c) trainedness gate re-specified as the real distance ||W_p1 - W_init||_F summed over every head tensor, ARM_ON cells only (no pool-arm veto), described as LIVENESS (one Adam step moves the 32-parameter last layer ~2.8e-3); 822e's signed difference-of-norms is recorded as a diagnostic only; (d) C4 (SD-078 contrast) kept through three-valued logic with DETECTABILITY pre-registered: at n=5 with 822e's contrast_sd 1.694 the one-sided detectable effect is 1.62 (6.5x the 0.25 margin; ~207 seeds would deliver the margin), so dir_078 = supports/weakens only with the seed clause AND |t_like| >= 2.132, else inconclusive; unknown when C4's control-arm headroom fails; (e) provenance block as above. Registry sd082_candidate_discriminating_readout_locus: adjudicates H1-trained-discriminating-readout and H-init-structure ONLY (adjudicating_runs already carry V3-EXQ-822f); H2/H3/H4 are NOT adjudicated (manifest h_legs_not_adjudicated). claim_ids [SD-078, SD-082] per-claim directions; dir_082 from C1' only, dir_078 from C4 only. Substrate readiness (2.5/2.5a): identical construction to 822e (SD-082 amend engaged for two consecutive runs; no ree_core change); re-derive brake (2.5b): literal counts SD-082 3 / SD-078 5 meet N=2 but the confirmed autopsy releases on ONE ground (true ceiling count 1 -- 822c; 822b/822d hits are instrument/DV defects wearing an amend; this target instrument-only, action none) and REFUSES only a same-seed replay -- this design-changed successor is the licensed route; substrate-path overlap (2.5c): SD-082's own entry (corrupting, implemented_pending_validation) is the subject under validation, not an unrelated defect; mode-governance-engagement gated off (salience_affinity_input_cap unset). dv_headroom DECLARED (W5 rule): dv_headroom_trained_minus_init_index = reachable bound |D| <= max(trained, init) per-cell median, worst ARM_ON cell, floor_headroom signed, margin 1.0 (822e's per-seed trained medians 0.98-2.59 all clear); hr_c4 inherited (SD-078-scoped); 822e's hr_c1/hr_c2 recorded, no longer gating. readiness_failure_class (instrument | substrate | mixed | training_signal_absent) recorded so substrate_not_ready_requeue is not booked as substrate debt (autopsy learning 8). red-team (fable): CONTESTED -- F1 (between-seed init spread in a paired requirement) -> dropped from the requirement; F2 (headroom read tick dispersion) -> reachable-bound headroom; F3 (weakens over-reached SD-082's registered text; init-head dead-ReLU unrecorded) -> init-head dead-ReLU recorded per tick, claim-direction weakens requires comparable masks (|delta| <= 0.25, both < 0.5) AND the trained head failing absolute C1, registry reads the raw mirrored clause; N4 (inconclusive emitted as FAIL, one label for three paths) -> labels split, outcome_semantics + C1' detectable effect recorded; N5 (pairing conditional on the trained agent's states) -> init-median vs summary-spread correlation recorded; N6 (flat P1 reward reads as instrument; last-layer-only distance) -> summed distance, n_p1_optimizer_updates, training_signal_absent class; N7 recorded. No second pass (not BLOCKING). validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings); --dry-run smoke (2 seeds, P0/P1/P2 3/3/3) runs end-to-end twice: init head reads at every tick (init index per seed recorded), liveness distance passes, toy-scale readiness reds (n_prop 4 vs 20, head-diag) are the expected starvation reds and were classed `instrument`. Cross-machine-class safe: deterministic forward passes and medians, no torch.multinomial assertion. Runtime: 822e took 2h04m on ree-cloud-2 for 10 cells; 822f adds one init-head forward pass per measurement tick (32-parameter head) -> ~2h10m.

items.title: MECH-161 inverted-U heartbeat sweep, INSTRUMENT-FIXED: decision-tick avoidance readout, per-step quantile hazard bins, measured conditional-oracle + hazard-blind-null arms deriving the bar at every P, P0 over all seeds (supersedes V3-EXQ-999)
items.note: Instrument-fixed re-queue of V3-EXQ-999 (same question: MECH-161's inverted-U over the E3 heartbeat period P; letter retained) per the CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-999_2026-09-04 (governance-20260904-1347; Fable red-team CONTESTED, F1-F6 accepted; brake count 0, instrument category). 999 aborted at its FIRST seed on a P0 gate that a PERFECT avoider also fails (+0.0000 vs +0.05) and whose policy-free nulls score -0.06 to -0.44; the readout scored every held step, so sensitivity(P) was monotone in the hold period that IS the IV (F2). THE FIVE NON-NEGOTIABLES (routing_note_2026_09_04), each met: (1) the avoidance readout is scored ONLY at E3 decision ticks (`_agent_tick` returns a fresh-decision flag; all-step sensitivity retained as a diagnostic), with readiness null_sensitivity_flat_in_P (noise-aware ceiling) checking the confound is gone; (2) measured CONDITIONAL_ORACLE (threat-gated: away-from-hazard argmax in the HIGH bin, random otherwise -- the avoider the red team showed scores +0.905; an always-avoid oracle scores 0 by construction) and HAZARD_BLIND_NULL arms run at EVERY P on the same env/seed/decision schedule (3x the agent's episodes, policy-free), deriving the P0 bar (agent >= null + 0.25*(oracle-null) at P_train) and normalising C1's DV: s_norm(P) = (agent-null)/(oracle-null); (3) P0 evaluated over ALL seeds (no seed-one abort), gates: hazard_field_replica_matches_obs, high_bin_decision_ticks_covered, safe_bin_executable_decision_ticks_covered, oracle_null_separation (>= 0.20 worst cell), null flatness, derived baseline bar, dv_headroom_interior_margin; a red gate is CLASSIFIED (readiness_failure_class instrument | env_band_absent | avoidance_untrained) and adjudicates the registry legs -- H-readout-invalid (instrument gates), H-avoidance-untrained (agent fails the derived bar on a VALID instrument -> supported: a real finding routed to the learning-signal axis), H-env-band-absent (executable SAFE bin under-covered); (4) per-STEP quantile bins from the env's own hazard_field over non-wall cells (SAFE <= q0.35, HIGH >= q0.65; hazards drift within an episode so the field is re-read each step; the replica gate certifies hazard_field_view[12] == field[agent]/max to 1e-8), false-alarm rate scored over EXECUTABLE SAFE ticks only (a wall-clamped away-action cannot express flight from nothing; clamp fraction recorded); (5) every cell's per-bin n/avoidant, hit, false-alarm, coverage, wall-clamp fraction, n_e3_ticks, committed_fraction, world_forward_r2 stamped in every verdict path. TRAINING UNCHANGED from 999 (no action policy on harm; NAV_BIAS 0.25): H-avoidance-untrained is adjudicated, not pre-empted. C1 unchanged in form on the normalised curve: interior maximum beating both extremes by >= max(0.05, 1 sd pooled); DV-movement floor 0.05 normalised. Claim scope = the SHAPE premise only (operating-point sweep, MECH-093's regulator output overwritten each tick); MECH-161's REGULATOR assertion is not tested and the manifest says so. EVAL_EPISODES_PER_LEVEL 30 (999: 20) for decision-tick bin coverage. dv_headroom DECLARED (W5 rule): dv_headroom_interior_margin = the worst-level measured (oracle-null) decision-tick separation vs 2x the raw margin floor 0.03 (floor_headroom, signed). GOV-REUSE-1: no manifest carries a decision-tick avoidance readout or oracle/null arms (999 aborted; 981 all-step) -> run. Substrate readiness (2.5/2.5a): MECH-093 rate knob live and forced per tick (999's manipulation-reach fix retained); 2.5c: dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class (degrading) names MECH-161 -- this run's gates are the repair it names; no corrupting overlap. Registry mech161_vigilance_arousal_shape_vs_readout: all three legs already bound to V3-EXQ-999a. Cross-machine-class: E3's uncommitted path draws torch.multinomial (committed_fraction recorded per level, as 999). Runtime: 999 took 44 min for ONE seed's warmup + one level; 5 seeds x (warmup 15000 steps + 5 levels x 3000 agent steps) + policy-free controls (3x episodes) -> ~5.5-6h; seeds 11/23/37/45/53. red-team (fable): PASS 1 BLOCKING (10 findings) -- F1: agent.update_residue at eval fired MECH-091's harm-salience phase_reset, so the forced period was NOT the agent's decision schedule (probe: at P=20, 37-54 reset ticks vs 12 scheduled) -> no residue update at eval, readiness gate decision_schedule_matches_P (realised ticks / (steps/P) within 1 +/- 0.25; smoke reads 1.0); F3 (hazard read from the grid, dropped when walked onto) -> env.hazards; F4 (flat truth -> weakens 63 percent by MC) -> mirrored weakens margin, else inconclusive; F5 (null flatness tautological) -> recorded only; F6 dismissed (construction checks); F7 (coverage min over the agent arm) -> control-arm vs agent-arm gates with own failure classes (agent_starves_high_bin / agent_starves_safe_bin); F8 closed via F1; F9 acknowledged (shape premise only); F10 -> per-arm env rebuild. PASS 2 (re-spawned once) CONTESTED -- N1 (env default contamination_spread 0.5 kills a STAY-holder at step 7, coupling survival to P through the held action) -> contamination_spread 0.0 on training AND eval envs, episode_end_reasons recorded; N2 (a starved control bin propagated as nan into the separation gate and was classed instrument) -> worst finite cell, env_band_absent classified first; N3 (flat-truth false-supports 16-19 percent at n=3) -> 5 seeds, MARGIN_SD_MULT 1.5, >= 3 contributing seeds per level; N4 recorded. No third pass. validate_experiments.py --strict clean; --dry-run smoke (2 seeds; eval 6 x 60; controls x3) runs end-to-end eight times across the revisions; with contamination off the control arms survive (HIGH coverage met at toy scale), the schedule gate reads exactly 1.0, the replica gate 1.3e-8; remaining toy-scale reds (executable SAFE ticks, separation in the worst cell) are the expected dry-run reds and scale out at 30 x 100 eval steps. Cross-machine-class: E3's uncommitted path draws torch.multinomial (committed_fraction recorded per level). Pacing note: queued while un-adjudicated on origin = 1 (V3-EXQ-1013, PASS).

entries: dv_headroom_interior_margin (C1: MARGIN_ABS_FLOOR 0.03 raw vs the worst-level measured (oracle - null) decision-tick separation, floor_headroom signed, margin 2.0 -- the instrument's dynamic range the normalised margin is scaled by)
dv_headroom.measured_range_source: 999 autopsy probes: conditional oracle +0.905 unheld vs +0.038 held at P=10 (all-step readout); hazard-blind nulls -0.06..-0.44 all-step; this run measures both arms at DECISION ticks at every P and reports them
